newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INTERVIEW-PMP SAYS TO SELL PROPERTY ASSETS.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-PMP SAYS TO SELL PROPERTY ASSETS.

text.p: Australian publisher PMP Communications Ltd on Tuesday said it was looking to sell property assets worth tens of million of dollars over the next 12 months to help it shed debt.
Managing director Ken Catlow, speaking after PMP reported a second straight drop in annual profit, said he wanted to slash debt to about A$300 million from around A$500 million now.
"What we would like to do over the next couple of years is get it down to around the A$300 million mark," Catlow told Reuters.
